definitions.fresh_source_per_s: median of render report-window new-source count divided by that report span; not FPS
definitions.timing_units: timing CSV XrTime nanoseconds; percentiles are milliseconds
definitions.stream_scope: stream 0; one stereo picture stream, counts are pictures not per-eye doubled frames

optimistic_recovery.eligibility: after any confirmation, bypasses only !heldst.confirms(src); still requires ref_slot, no missing, no due refresh, valid atlas, and displacement pass
optimistic_recovery.refresh: with drift_refresh, age_since_intra increments for every non-INTRA tile and due forces INTRA at configured period; without drift_refresh, staggered refresh_due still forces candidates. However superseded atlas entries can override due/missing into WARP_SKIP, so no unconditional per-tile refresh guarantee. Negative not-held feedback can force refresh.
